histogram.name: MultistepFilter.Acceptance
histogram.summary: Records the overall user acceptance outcome (from Cue or Omnibox) for Multistep Filter suggestion. Recorded when the user accepts, dismisses, or opens settings for a Multistep Filter suggestion, or when the user ignores the suggestion upon navigating away or closing the tab.

histogram.name: MultistepFilter.Acceptance.ByTask.{TaskType}
histogram.summary: Records the overall user acceptance outcome (from Cue or Omnibox) for Multistep Filter suggestion for task type {TaskType}. Recorded when the user accepts, dismisses, or opens settings for a Multistep Filter suggestion, or when the user ignores the suggestion upon navigating away or closing the tab.

histogram.name: MultistepFilter.Acceptance.InitialCue
histogram.summary: Records the user acceptance outcome on the initial cue for Multistep Filter suggestion. Recorded when the user interacts with the initial cue bubble (accepts, dismisses, or opens settings) or when the cue bubble times out and collapses into the Omnibox.

histogram.name: MultistepFilter.Acceptance.InitialCue.ByTask.{TaskType}
histogram.summary: Records the user acceptance outcome on the initial cue for Multistep Filter suggestion for task type {TaskType}. Recorded when the user interacts with the initial cue bubble (accepts, dismisses, or opens settings) or when the cue bubble times out and collapses into the Omnibox.

histogram.name: MultistepFilter.Acceptance.ReopenedCue
histogram.summary: Records user acceptance outcome with the Multistep Filter suggestion cue (after it is reopened from the Omnibox). Recorded when the user interacts with a reopened Omnibox suggestion (accepts, dismisses, or opens settings) or when the user ignores the Omnibox suggestion upon navigating away or closing the tab.

histogram.name: MultistepFilter.Acceptance.ReopenedCue.ByTask.{TaskType}
histogram.summary: Records user acceptance outcome with the Multistep Filter suggestion cue (after it is reopened from the Omnibox) for task type {TaskType}. Recorded when the user interacts with a reopened Omnibox suggestion (accepts, dismisses, or opens settings) or when the user ignores the Omnibox suggestion upon navigating away or closing the tab.

histogram.name: MultistepFilter.ApplicationOutcome
histogram.summary: Records the overall technical filter application outcome after a user accepts a Multistep Filter suggestion. "All filter facets successfully applied" (kAllFiltersApplied) means that after the navigation completed, the landing page's URL was successfully parsed, and the extracted filter attributes exactly matched the suggested filters (same keys and values). "Not successfully applied" (kNotAllFiltersApplied) covers cases where: - The navigation failed (error page) or was to an unsupported scheme. - No filter attributes could be extracted from the landing page. - The number of extracted attributes did not match the suggested count. - There was a mismatch in the keys or values of the filters (e.g. a different brand or price range was applied than what was suggested).

histogram.name: MultistepFilter.ApplicationOutcome.ByTask.{TaskType}
histogram.summary: Records the overall technical filter application outcome after a user accepts a Multistep Filter suggestion for task type {TaskType}. "All filter facets successfully applied" (kAllFiltersApplied) means that after the navigation completed, the landing page's URL was successfully parsed, and the extracted filter attributes exactly matched the suggested filters (same keys and values). "Not successfully applied" (kNotAllFiltersApplied) covers cases where: - The navigation failed (error page) or was to an unsupported scheme. - No filter attributes could be extracted from the landing page. - The number of extracted attributes did not match the suggested count. - There was a mismatch in the keys or values of the filters (e.g. a different brand or price range was applied than what was suggested).

histogram.name: MultistepFilter.ApplicationOutcome.ByTask.{TaskType}.ByFacet.{FacetType}
histogram.summary:
Records the application outcome (success or failure) for the {FacetType} filter facet when it was part of an accepted Multistep Filter suggestion for task type {TaskType}.
Note that we only measure the overall application outcome: a facet is recorded as successfully applied (true) if and only if all facets in the accepted suggestion were successfully applied (i.e. the landing page's URL was parsed and all suggested attributes matched). If any facet fails to apply, or if the navigation/extraction fails, all facets in the suggestion are recorded as failed (false).

histogram.name: MultistepFilter.NumberOfFacetsShown
histogram.summary: Records the number of filter facets (attributes) contained within a Multistep Filter suggestion when the suggestion is successfully shown to the user (e.g. when the suggestion cue UI is displayed). Only recorded if at least one facet is present.

histogram.name: MultistepFilter.NumberOfFacetsShown.ByTask.{TaskType}
histogram.summary: Records the number of filter facets (attributes) contained within a Multistep Filter suggestion when the suggestion is successfully shown to the user (e.g. when the suggestion cue UI is displayed) for task type {TaskType}. Only recorded if at least one facet is present.

histogram.name: MultistepFilter.NumberOfFacetsSuccessfullyApplied
histogram.summary:
Records the number of filter facets (attributes) that were successfully applied after the user accepted a Multistep Filter suggestion.
Note that this is only recorded when the overall suggestion application succeeds (i.e., all facets in the suggestion were successfully applied to the landing page). If the application fails (e.g. if any facet mismatch occurs or the navigation fails), nothing is recorded to this histogram (we do not log 0).

histogram.name: MultistepFilter.NumberOfFacetsSuccessfullyApplied.ByTask.{TaskType}
histogram.summary:
Records the number of filter facets (attributes) that were successfully applied after the user accepted a Multistep Filter suggestion for task type {TaskType}.
Note that this is only recorded when the overall suggestion application succeeds (i.e., all facets in the suggestion were successfully applied to the landing page). If the application fails (e.g. if any facet mismatch occurs or the navigation fails), nothing is recorded to this histogram (we do not log 0).
